[SWS_PER_00551]
⌈
When ara::per::FileStorage::OpenFileReadOnly (or
one of the overloaded versions ara::per::FileStorage::OpenFileReadOnly
with ara::per::OpenMode or ara::per::FileStorage::OpenFileReadOnly
with ara::per::OpenMode and separate buffer) is called, Persistency shall first
check whether the file is present in the File Storage, and otherwise return di-
rectly with kFileNotFound.
